Lemma
[Evolution of the Laplacian] Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0121 1. Lemma 5.4\group evolution-equations-on-surfaces

Let $g(t)$ be a smooth $1$-parameter family of metrics on $\mathcal M^n$. Then for any smooth function $u$, \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}(\Delta u) =\Delta \! \left(\frac{\partial u}{\partial t}\right) -\left\langle \frac{\partial g}{\partial t},\Hess u\right\rangle \] and, in particular, if $g(t)$ satisfies the normalized Ricci flow on a surface, then \[ \frac{\partial }{\partial t}\Delta =(R-r)\Delta . \]

Proof

Source: chow-knopf-ricci-flow:page-0121 \sketch Differentiate the local coordinate formula for $\Delta $ and use the evolution of the inverse metric and Christoffel symbols. On a surface under the normalized Ricci flow, $\partial _t g=(r-R)g$, so the tensorial correction reduces to multiplication by $R-r$.

□
